gpu_tip: ~48GB total at 128K context. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit; prefer UD-Q3_K_XL or UD-IQ3_XXS whenever the memory is there. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 48GB DDR5 kit just covers it via expert offloading; 64GB is comfortable.
mac_tip: Needs ~48GB — too tight for a 48GB MacBook Pro; a 64GB config (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) fits it.
